keywords_en: Ethereum's roadmap shifts to an endgame mindset
a delayed metadata update extension for ERC-8004
summary_en: A quiet Sunday. nero_eth stressed that privacy should be Ethereum's default rather than a luxury. tcoratger summarized drakefjustin's view that the roadmap is shifting from incremental upgrades to an endgame mindset. Agent ERCs kept coming, including an AI-Native NFT and a delayed metadata update extension for ERC-8004.
